meaning: Historical silicon orbital observations and independent monoenergetic primary-proton CSDA examples; no surface/human dose acceptance.

cases.environment: Hypothetical monoenergetic protons at normal incidence on a uniform slab

orbitalObservations.classification: UNH CRaTER PI legacy derived orbital observations
orbitalObservations.meaning: Arithmetic mean of qualifying archived daily rates only. No missing-day fill, dose integration, surface conversion or mission-time forecast.

cases.meaning: Historical silicon detector dose rates and a separate primary-proton CSDA comparison. Residual energy is not a dose-reduction percentage or a safety verdict.
exclusions: No GCR/SEP spectrum, particle fluence, nuclear reactions/secondary neutron transport, range straggling, scattering or angular shielding geometry.
The NIST CSDA path range is used as a straight normal-slab approximation; it is distinct from projected range. Bulk density is a NIST material reference.
CRaTER is historical lunar-orbital silicon detector context. Gy in silicon is not Sv in tissue; lunar-shadow correction is not a surface/human-dose conversion.
No terrain solid-angle dose multiplier, future-date prediction, exposure limit, health risk or validated shelter/hardware protection result. Source uncertainties are not propagated.
